blocks.prompt: 9. Use factor theorem to find the values of \(p\) and \(q\) if \(x + 1\) and \(x - 2\) are the factors of the polynomial \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx + 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Do unknowns \(p\) aur \(q\) hain, aur do factors diye gaye hain; har factor se ek equation milegi.
Factor theorem: agar \(x - a\) factor hai to \(f(a) = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? \(p\) aur \(q\) ki values.
Plan: \(f(-1) = 0\) aur \(f(2) = 0\) likhna, do linear equations ko hal karna, aur aakhir mein check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^{3} + px^{2} + qx + 3\); \(x + 1\) aur \(x - 2\) factors hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(p\) aur \(q\).
Tareeqa: Factor theorem: \(x - a\) factor hai to \(f(a) = 0\). Do factors se do equations banengi, aur do equations se do unknowns nikal aate hain.

\(q\) ko khatam karein: (1) ko 2 se multiply kar ke (2) mein jama karein
\[2p - 2q = -4\]
\[4p + 2q = -11\]
\[6p = -15\]
\[p = -\dfrac{5}{2}\]
Kyun: (1) ko 2 se multiply kiya taake us mein \(-2q\) aa jaye; (2) mein \(+2q\) hai, jama karne se dono cancel. Phir \(p = -15/6\), jise 3 se simplify kiya to \(-5/2\).
Dhyan dein: Jawab fraction mein aaye to ghabrayein nahi; har sawal ka jawab poora number nahi hota.

(1) se \(q\) nikalein
\[q = p + 2\]
\[= -\dfrac{5}{2} + 2 = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(p - q = -2\) se \(q = p + 2\). \(2 = \frac{4}{2}\) likh kar jama kiya: \(-\frac{5}{2} + \frac{4}{2} = -\frac{1}{2}\).

Tasdeeq
\[f(-1) = -1 - \tfrac{5}{2} + \tfrac{1}{2} + 3 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[f(2) = 8 - 10 - 1 + 3 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(p = -\frac{5}{2}\) aur \(q = -\frac{1}{2}\) rakhein to \(p(-1)^{2} = -\frac{5}{2}\), \(q(-1) = \frac{1}{2}\), \(4p = -10\), \(2q = -1\). Dono values zero aayin, yani dono factors sahi baith gaye aur jawab pakka hai.
